## Systems Engineering & Architecture {#systems-engineering-and-architecture}

I use systems engineering and architecture principles to connect stakeholder needs with technical decisions. This means considering the system as a whole, its components and their interfaces, and using modelling and validation to support effective engineering solutions.

## Agile Methodology {#agile-methodology}

I apply Agile practices to support collaboration in multidisciplinary teams and adapt to changing project needs. By working iteratively, reviewing progress and incorporating feedback, I aim to deliver high-quality outcomes for clients and public stakeholders.
